integrity: The proof is symbolic. The matching facts are classical; the claimed contribution is the exact identification of perfect grid states with perfect matchings of the minimizer graph and the resulting complete trichotomy that resolves a limitation explicitly noted in the 2026 source. The bundled exhaustive computation is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: This is a fixed-grid-diagram classification. It does not settle whether every fibered knot admits a nice grid diagram and does not classify maximal states that fail to attain the row or column bound.
title: Perfect-matching trichotomy for perfect grid states
